calculate_search_provider_cost: calculate the cost for a search provider query given a model name and number of queries
calculate_tiered_search_cost: calculate search provider cost with tiered pricing based on max_results parameter
calculate_multiple_search_costs: calculate total cost for multiple search queries using a specified model and provider
get_search_cost_tuple: get input and output cost tuple for a search-only provider model
calculate_flat_rate_search_cost: calculate search cost using flat rate pricing when no tiered pricing is configured
